problem_type: Untrusted prompt provenance is not enforced at the action confirmation and ledger projection boundaries
symptom: A model tool call can be confirmed without a structured decision showing that untrusted prompt sources drove a spend, write, or egress action, and the Host ledger has no honest source projection.
direct_cause: Runtime tool confirmation receives only the raw call, while Agent responses and Project Agent tool items discard the compiled prompt provenance receipt.
class_root: Every risky tool call must pass the shared provenance action guard before Host confirmation, and every settled tool item must project the same source/taint receipt without copying asset license evidence.
affected_population: All Agent tool calls classified as spend, write, or egress
All Project Agent ledger rows created from Agent tool calls
Users relying on confirmation cards to understand why an action is blocked or requires approval
internal_only_reason: M4's action and projection semantics are defined by the checked-in M-line rulings, Creative Resource Chain M4 shared-point contract, PromptPipe M3 contract, and functional conformance spec.
invariants: A spend, write, or egress call with any tainted source is never silently allowed; it must receive an explicit Host confirmation or a rejection containing a human-readable reason.
Read-only calls and calls with no tainted source do not acquire an extra provenance confirmation requirement.
Agent responses and Host ledger tool items expose derived provenance source, trust, taint, and source references; ledger projection does not embed a second AssetSourceEvidence snapshot.
The action guard and ledger projection consume the final PromptPipe receipt, so model-produced output inherits the turn's source summary.
generality_proof: All runtime tool executions converge on runAgentChatV2's awaitToolConfirmation hook, and all persisted tool rows converge on toolItem; placing the guard and projection there covers provider, Skill, MCP, and future tool aliases without caller-specific bypasses.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Fail closed to a required confirmation whenever a risky action has tainted source references.
Apply the guard before delegating to the Host confirmation hook and attach the exact prompt receipt to the runtime and response.
Persist the response's hash-free provenance projection as the Host ledger's source summary.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: Agent response to Host tool-item settlement
same_class_entry_points.evidence: The coordinator passes AgentChatResponse.provenance into the sole toolItem projection path before dispatching the settled result.
MCP capability dispatch is not an Agent model tool execution path; its own capability contracts remain the effect boundary and do not consume PromptPipe receipts.

recurrence.reason: New tools, aliases, Skill/MCP adapters, and future output surfaces can otherwise discard or bypass the source summary at confirmation or persistence time.
same_class_scan: Searched all RuntimeTurnHooks.awaitToolConfirmation implementations and all toolItem call sites.
Checked semantic tool risk descriptors and existing Host confirmation/ledger routes for risky action aliases.
Added guard unit tests and Host ledger projection coverage; retained AssetSourceEvidence as the only asset evidence contract.

prevention.invariant: No risky runtime tool call reaches Host confirmation without evaluating the final PromptPipe taint set, and no settled tool row is created without the response provenance projection when one exists.
prevention.failure_mode: Tainted risky calls remain pending for explicit confirmation; rejection receives a translated plain-language reason and a stable reason code. Ledger rows retain refs and taint, not duplicated license snapshots.
prevention.strategy: Guard at the single runtime confirmation hook, project at the single Host ledger constructor, and make source metadata part of the existing response/receipt contract.

legacy_paths.rationale: The implementation extends the existing single confirmation and ledger paths; it does not retain a second action guard or a parallel provenance snapshot.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The guard and projection use existing Nomi contracts and Electron i18n; no third-party package controls the invariant.

migration: Legacy Agent responses and ledger rows without provenance remain valid; new turns emit the optional projection, and old rows are not rewritten or falsely backfilled.
residual_risks: The current production Host coordinator does not yet expose a separate visual taint badge; the ledger projection is available for the existing UI projection path.
AssetSourceEvidence v2 remains dependent on unmerged PR #388 in this stacked branch.
